name: scan-to-model
description: Preserve Polycam exports, measure native depth, validate rigid scan alignment, and build evidence-backed Blender models.

interface.shortDescription: Turn scan evidence into reviewable Blender models.
interface.longDescription: A local workflow with skills and Python tools for source preservation, calibrated native depth, surface measurement, rigid registration, coverage planning, and Blender review. Keeps unknown geometry and registration limits explicit.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use scan-to-model to inventory my scans, assess coverage and native depth, and build a source-backed Blender candidate.
